{"summary":"Ordinary review of the WP03 publication shell diff (public-policy.tsx plus two test files). No BLOCKER or MAJOR issues found. The component change is small and does what the brief asks. Draft section headings and paragraphs still render through the unchanged `section.paragraphs.map(...)` path. No version or effective date is invented: the shell shows \"尚未發布\" and \"尚未生效\" and never renders `draft.status` or `draft.owner`. The footer now uses reader-facing wording, and the legacy support/merchant notices were not touched. Remaining items are MINOR/NIT: forward-looking copy, `aria-label` on a `
`, a duplicated notice style, whole-file line-ending churn in the tests, a stale test name, a possible type issue in a test fixture, and a paragraph assertion that checks containment against the current source rather than a baseline. D5 formal contents remain deferred and the entire WP03 remains INCOMPLETE; this shell change does not close it. No legal-advice review was performed.","findings":[{"severity":"MINOR","area":"Reader-facing copy","file":"src/components/public-policy.tsx","issue":"The notice says 正式版本與生效日期確認後會在本頁公布 (the official version and effective date will be announced on this page once confirmed). That is a forward-looking commitment about where and how publication will happen, and no approved owner has authorized it.","evidence":"

以下內容為草稿，尚未生效；正式版本與生效日期確認後會在本頁公布。

","impact":"Readers may take it as a promise of a publication channel and timing.
